info.name: Esep API
info.description:
Wallets and transfers with a double-entry ledger.

Run folders in order: Auth -> Accounts -> Transactions -> Analytics -> Security -> Errors (or Run collection).
Dev seed users (password `password123`): alice@esep.dev, bob@esep.dev (USER), admin@esep.dev (ADMIN).
Auth/Login requests save JWTs to aliceToken, bobToken, adminToken; other requests use them as Bearer tokens.
Idempotency keys are generated in pre-request scripts; the 'retry' request reuses the previous key on purpose.
